title: Joint generalized eigenspaces span for commuting split operators
statement:
Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $V$ be a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], let $I$ be any index set (possibly empty), and let $(T_i)_{i\in I}$ be $k$-linear endomorphisms of $V$. For $\lambda\in k$ write
$$E^{\mathrm{gen}}_{i,\lambda}=\bigcup_{n\geq1}\ker((T_i-\lambda\operatorname{id}_V)^n).$$
Assume $T_iT_j=T_jT_i$ for all $i,j$ and $\sum_{\lambda\in k}E^{\mathrm{gen}}_{i,\lambda}=V$ for every $i$. Then
$$\sum_{\chi\in k^I}\bigcap_{i\in I}E^{\mathrm{gen}}_{i,\chi(i)}=V.$$
Here a sum of subspaces consists of finite sums of their vectors, and an empty intersection is $V$. The zero vector space is allowed.
